class.name: TweensGdPlayback
class.brief_description: A low-level timeline clock without a target or value writes.
class.description: Use [method create] and [method advance] to inspect timeline timing. Ordinary animation uses [TweensGdHandle] and [TweensGdScheduler]. The C# counterpart is the internal playback clock, not the public handle.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the clock by [param delta] seconds. Pass a finite, nonnegative value; this low-level clock performs no validation. Writes no target values.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a timeline clock from a definition. Does not validate configuration or start animation. Pass a valid definition; null creates the default zero-duration clock.

members.member: True once the final cycle completed.
